title: Kavi
text: Kiṃsu nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ || kiṃsu tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ || kiṃsu sannissitā gāthā || kiṃsu gāthānam āsayo ti || || Chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ || akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ || nāmasannissitā gāthā || kavi gāthānam āsayo ti || || Jarā-vaggo chaṭṭho || Tass-uddānam || || Jarā Ajarasā Mittaṃ || Vatthu tīṇi Janāni ca || Uppatho ca Dutiyo ca || Kavinā purito vaggo ti || || [page 039] I. 7. 5.] ADDHA-VAGGA 7. 39 ___________________________________________ CHAPTER VII. ADDHA-VAGGO.
